tools.name: get_terms_of_service
tools.description: Retrieve Terms of Service conditions for AnyCompany. Specify the type to get details about Delivery, Payment, or Refund conditions.

type.description: The type of Terms of Service to retrieve. Must be one of: Delivery, Payment, or Refund.

tools.name: accept_terms_of_service
tools.description: Record that a user has accepted the current Terms of Service.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user accepting the terms.

tools.name: check_terms_acceptance
tools.description: Check whether a specific user has accepted the Terms of Service.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user to check.
